What to focus on · known before the game

Their marksman, Smolder (Bot), is the confirmed win condition. Marksmen are the one class the model confirms turns gold into wins faster: about 2 to 5 points more per 1,000 gold than the rest of their role. Don't let them get ahead.
Gold in minutes 8 to 12 is worth about twice as much as later gold, for both teams.
On your side, Sivir is the one to feed: your marksman's gold converts best.
The margin of error includes zero: the real effect could be nothing. Read it as a hint, not a fact.
win chance per 1,000 gold. Apart from marksmen, these values are too close to rank: their ranges overlap.

Attributions are correlational, not causal: gold leads predict wins, but this isn't an experiment. Everything about champions is measured by class (role + type): at this data volume, a specific champion can't be separated from its class.
